Now here is the Lean4game + NNG port to WASM64. Try it out here deployed. Please use chrome and a decent RAM :)

https://lean4game.fawadworkaddress.workers.dev

The forked repo is here

https://github.com/FawadHa1der/lean4game/tree/wasm64-port

Will be adding more games soon to it.

Also try out my WASM64 playground editor (prev post), I (honestly claude) have been updating it and improving stability
Great! Do you have plans to add permalinks to the playground?
hmmm it runs completely on the client, your machine. Could you explain more how you are envisaging? like GitHub permalink right? that might not work here I think

You can check out my work here too, feel free to use it. It was a very similar project for 4.27 Lean specifically. There are real upstreamable bug fixes here, according to Claude. I do not have the expertise at that low a level (advanced threading in C vs WASM etc.) to know. But it's at least worth seeing if your agent can get any use out of it. Thanks for sharing!
